title: Member Benefits Schedule: Wayfare Pass Goodwill on Cleaning and Damage Fees Repair Charges
content:
The Pass goodwill of a Cleaning and Damage Fees damage fee approved at review is read from the rider's Wayfare Pass membership in active status: Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly, Wayfare Pass Plus Annual and Wayfare Pass All Access Annual take the Plus-tier damage goodwill; Wayfare Pass Monthly, Wayfare Pass Annual and Wayfare Pass Student take the base-tier damage goodwill; a rider with no active membership takes no Pass goodwill.

| Plan of the rider's Wayfare Pass (rider membership), in active status | Pass goodwill on a damage fee |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly, Wayfare Pass Plus Annual, Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | $25.00 (Plus-tier damage goodwill) |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly, Wayfare Pass Annual, Wayfare Pass Student | $10.00 (base-tier damage goodwill) |
| no membership in active status | none |

The plan and status are read from the rider's membership record in Wayfare Pass (rider membership); a membership in trial, paused, past due, pending cancellation or cancelled status is not an active membership.

The Pass goodwill is a fixed amount subtracted from the damage fee once the fee has been held to its ceiling.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A capped damage fee of $750.00 for a rider on an active Wayfare Pass Plus Annual membership becomes $725.00 after the Pass goodwill; for a rider on an active Wayfare Pass Student membership it becomes $740.00.
